To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the replacement of coarse aggregate by 10% of fly ash aggregates and 12% of cement by silica fume gives good performance for the mechanical properties like Compressed strength and split tensile strength.

the concrete cube, cylinders and beams made of 12% replacement cement with silica fum and 20% of coarse aggregate by fly ash aggregate are found to have good performance in all the mechanical properties when compared to other mix proportion and normal concrete.
the compressive strength of concrete increases when 20% fly ash aggregate is used in place of normal coarse aggregate.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the use of fly ash aggregate and silica fume as a partial replacement for coarse aggregate and cement respectively.

the effect of partial replacement of fly ash aggregate and cement with Silica fume in concrete and the effect of partial substitution of cement with fly ash aggregate and Silica fume on the mechanical properties of concrete.
the use of fly ash aggregate and silica fume in the concrete and their effect on mechanical properties of concrete.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the use of silica fume in cement replacement and fly ash aggregate in coarse aggregate replacement in concrete is an excellent method for producing high strength and durable concrete with less cost and environmental friendly.

the replacement of coarse aggregate by 0%, 8%, 12% and16% with fly ash aggregates and replacement of cement with 0%, 12% with silica fume is a viable and effective alternative to the traditional method of construction of concrete.
the concrete with fly ash aggregate and silica fume is a good replacement of cement and coarse aggregate in the concrete.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the replacement of coarse aggregate by 10% with fly ash and cement by 12% with silica fume gives good performance in all the mechanical properties.
, the concrete made with partial replacement of fly ash aggregate and cement with 12% of silica fume is the best option for the use of fly ash aggregate.
, by using fly ash aggregate in the concrete can be reduce the weight of the concrete, and by using silica fume in the concrete can improve the strength of the concrete.
The main takeaway from our work is that

, we can use fly ash aggregate in the concrete to reduce the environmental pollution and also to reduce the weight of the structure and we can use the silica fume in the concrete to improve the mechanical properties of the structure.
fly ash aggregate can replace coarse aggregate and silica fume can replace cement in concrete.
the use of silica fume in cement and fly ash aggregate in coarse aggregate can improve the mechanical properties of the concrete.
